answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns a prism of fees that splits its budget thin. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so a raven-flock of extra identities buys no edge — the cost bends to the work like a willow, never the head count.
